description: A room is being decorated for a party. Two hands press a paper chain against a white wall, running through red, orange, yellow, green and blue links. Pale pink and deep blue balloons are stuck to the wall above a grey sofa. The rainbow chain is then strung in a curve above a row of grey triangular bunting. In the evening the room is lit up: a man on a stepladder hangs bright garlands under a canopy of fairy lights while a woman holds a pink balloon, and the whole floor disappears under hundreds of pink, blue, orange, yellow and silver balloons.

taps.phrase: to hang up a paper chain
